goal: Inventory the infrastructure the insrc repo defines and establish how it is built and released via its GitHub Actions workflows

tasks.rationale: Detect every IaC family in the insrc repo to confirm the bundle's finding that only ci (4 GitHub Actions workflows) is present.
Enumerate triggers, jobs and step uses of ci.yml; the bundle has its identity only, so this establishes the main build and test pipeline.
Enumerate triggers, jobs and step uses of pages.yml to establish what it publishes and when; the bundle gives the file name only.
Enumerate triggers, jobs and step uses of jetbrains-plugin.yml to establish how the JetBrains plugin is built and released.
Enumerate triggers, jobs and step uses of vscode-plugin.yml to establish how the VS Code plugin is built and released.
Verify whether any Dockerfile or compose file exists, since the graph shows zero docker hits and its coverage is not established; image builds bear on release.
Verify the absence of Kubernetes manifests reported by the graph, so the report can state whether any deployable cluster resources are defined.
Verify the absence of Helm charts reported by the graph, so the report's claim of no packaged deployment charts rests on a direct probe.
Verify the absence of Terraform configurations reported by the graph, so the report can state whether any cloud resources are provisioned from this repo.
Stitch the family detection, the four per-workflow CI inventories and the four absence checks into the final report on defined infra and the build and release path.

reasoning: The bundle shows the repo's only indexed infra is four GitHub Actions workflows, with file identities but no contents, and notes the graph's coverage is not established. The plan runs family discovery, then one file-scoped CI inventory per workflow (ci.yml, pages.yml, jetbrains-plugin.yml, vscode-plugin.yml) to get triggers, jobs and publish steps, which is the build and release answer, following one leaf per unit. Docker, kubernetes, helm and terraform inventories confirm the reported absences directly. The four CI tasks necessarily share the template's fixed `ci-inventory` output name, since the catalog offers no other CI template. infra.adherence.check is omitted: the focus is inventory and no doc constraints are supplied. Ten tasks meets the M band's lower bound of 10.
